lines.text: RAMS, and safe systems of work.
Before you start any job, you must be briefed on its risk assessment and method statement, known as the RAMS.
And the controls you must follow.
You'll be asked to confirm that you've read and understood the RAMS for your work.
the conditions aren't what was expected,
or the RAMS no longer match what you're doing:
stop, and speak to your supervisor.
Never improvise, or work outside the agreed method, without authorisation.
Signing the RAMS isn't just paperwork. It confirms you understand how to do the job safely.
Know the plan. Follow the plan.
